nodes.description: initialize(): initializer that runs __Ownable_init and __UUPSUpgradeable_init
startTrainingTokens(address,uint16[]): external, stakes caller-owned NFTs and records block.timestamp
claimFromTraining(uint16[],bool): external whenNotPaused, computes time-based rewards/stats, unstakes NFTs and transfers AGOLD
setGolemsAndDragons(address): onlyOwner setter of the NFT contract address
setAncientGold(address): onlyOwner setter of the reward token address
getAllStakes(address): view returning the stake array of a user
_authorizeUpgrade(address): onlyOwner upgrade authorization hook for UUPS
onERC721Received(address,address,uint256,bytes): ERC721 receiver callback executed on safeTransferFrom
bool private _paused; pause flag used by whenPaused/whenNotPaused modifiers
IGolemsAndDragons public golemsAndDragons; external NFT contract reference
IAncientGold public ancientGold; external reward token contract reference
uint256 public totalTokensStaked; counter of staked tokens
mapping(uint256=>uint256) stakeIndices; tokenId to index inside the owner's stake array
mapping(address=>Stake[]) stakes; per-user stake records
uint256 constant TTE = 1 days; time-to-earn denominator
uint256 constant EARNINGS_RATE = 15000 ether; reward rate multiplier
uint256 constant HEALTH_RATE = 10; health stat rate
uint256 constant ATTACK_RATE = 1; attack stat rate
uint256 constant DEFENSE_RATE = 5; defense stat rate
uint256 constant AGILITY_RATE = 1; agility stat rate
msg.sender (via _msgSender()); attacker controllable caller identity
block.timestamp; miner-influenceable time source driving accrual
golemsAndDragons.transferFrom(...) external call pulling the NFT into the contract
golemsAndDragons.safeTransferFrom(...) external call returning the NFT, triggers onERC721Received
golemsAndDragons.addStats(...) external call to a user-settable NFT contract
ancientGold.bgTransfer(...) external payout call to a user-settable token contract
golemsAndDragons.ownerOf(...) external view call used for the ownership check
ancientGold.balanceOf(address(ancientGold)) external view call bounding the payout
(block.timestamp - stake.time) * RATE / TTE reward and stat arithmetic
address_ parameter of startTrainingTokens, the account stakes are credited to
uint16[] calldata tokens parameter of startTrainingTokens
uint16[] calldata tokens parameter of claimFromTraining
bool unstake parameter of claimFromTraining, selects withdraw vs restake branch
address contract_ parameter of setGolemsAndDragons
address contract_ parameter of setAncientGold
address user parameter of getAllStakes
address newImplementation parameter of _authorizeUpgrade
uint256 i loop index over the tokens arrays
uint256 earnings accumulator paid out via bgTransfer
uint256 balance = ancientGold.balanceOf(address(ancientGold)) used to cap earnings
Stake memory stake loaded from stakes[msg.sender][index]
Stake memory lastStake used for the swap-and-pop unstake pattern
uint256 health computed from elapsed time
uint256 attack computed from elapsed time
uint256 defense computed from elapsed time
uint256 agility computed from elapsed time
uint256 actualHealthRate, dragon-aware health rate
